purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: KCC publishes a general city-map page; KDA advertises a mouza/dag-based Detailed Area Plan, which is planning evidence rather than a verified land-title register. Direct HTML retrieval for the .gov.bd map sites failed normal TLS certificate validation; no certificate bypass was used. The national DLRS portal was not tied to a particular map sheet covering the exact ranked point. Registry source status therefore remains undetermined, and no parcel geometry/schema was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Khulna City Corporation site lists a city map page; indexed content alone does not establish cadastral content.
Official KCC portal page is titled “Khulna city map” and presents a map image, not a documented parcel vector service.

Khulna Development Authority site advertises the Detailed Area Plan map based on mouza and dag numbers, alongside planning/land-use services. This is planning material and was not verified as a cadastral register or anonymous parcel vector service.
DLRS national portal describes survey map and record services, but this review did not verify a city-point linked map sheet or city-scoped parcel geometry.
